name: Alexandria
title: Alexandria Hull Thickness Gauging and Ship UTM Services
description: Ultrasonic thickness measurement in Alexandria and El Dekheila: hull structure gauging for grain carriers and tankers, renewal survey and ESP gauging.
h1: Ultrasonic Thickness Gauging for Ships in Alexandria and El Dekheila
intro: Alexandria is Egypt's main Mediterranean port, with grain carriers discharging wheat, container and ro-ro traffic at Alexandria and El Dekheila, crude tankers at the Sidi Kerir terminal to the west, and drydocks at Alexandria Shipyard. Our technicians are mobilised from India for renewal-survey programmes in dock, empty-hold gauging after discharge, and targeted tanker work at the berth.

highlights.p: Egypt is one of the world's largest wheat importers, and bulk carriers discharging grain at Alexandria and El Dekheila leave with clean, empty holds. That is the window to gauge hold frames, brackets and hopper plating before the next cargo.

Alexandria Shipyard builds and repairs ships and operates drydock capacity in the port. A dock stay there opens up the bottom and side shell for measurement, and gauging early in the stay lets the steel list be agreed from measurements.

West of the city, the SUMED pipeline's Mediterranean terminal at Sidi Kerir loads crude tankers. Deck plating, ballast tanks and deck pipelines can be gauged during loading, under terminal rules, ahead of vetting or a CAP survey.

port.h: Alexandria's two harbours and their traffic
p: Alexandria handles a large share of Egypt's seaborne trade through two harbours run by the Alexandria Port Authority: the Western Harbour beside the city and El Dekheila a short distance further west. Between them they take container ships, general cargo ships, ro-ro and car carriers, and a steady flow of dry-bulk carriers bringing grain, which Egypt imports in great volume for bread. Beyond El Dekheila, the Sidi Kerir terminal at the Mediterranean end of the SUMED pipeline loads crude tankers, completing a route that lets large laden tankers avoid a full-draught transit of the Suez Canal.

Grain cargoes shape the gauging calendar. When a full grain cargo has been discharged, the holds are empty, swept and dry, which is the best condition a bulk carrier's holds are ever in for thickness measurement. An owner who knows a ship is discharging wheat in Alexandria can plan hold gauging for the days after discharge, before the ship sails in ballast to its next load port, and arrive at the next renewal or intermediate survey with frames, brackets and hopper plating already measured. Tankers at Sidi Kerir and ships alongside the container and ro-ro berths offer shorter windows, used for targeted deck, tank and piping work.

Alexandria is also a centre of Egyptian maritime education and ship repair. The Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport has its main campus in the city, and Alexandria Shipyard is one of the country's principal shipbuilding and repair yards, taking Egyptian-flag and foreign ships into dock for repair and survey. The result is a port where two kinds of gauging work sit side by side: full renewal-survey programmes in dock for ships in the yard, and targeted afloat work on the much larger number of ships that call to load or discharge and then leave.

facilities.h: Where ships are gauged in Alexandria
p: Alexandria Shipyard is the place for in-dock gauging: bottom plating, sea chests, bilge strakes and side shell, plus holds and tanks while the repair staging is in place. As in any yard, the value lies in measuring before the repair specification is finalised, so that the owner, the yard and the attending class surveyor agree the renewal list from fresh figures rather than from the previous report alone.

Afloat, the Western Harbour and El Dekheila berths give alongside access once the agent has the gate passes in hand, and the grain berths are where empty-hold gauging is most practical. At Sidi Kerir, work on tankers follows terminal safety rules on portable equipment and permits, and is limited to the deck, the ballast tanks and any spaces the master opens. Ships waiting outside the harbour can be boarded by launch, subject to the harbour master's arrangements and the agent's booking. For UTM in Alexandria the scope is set by the window: a dock stay supports a full programme, a discharge call supports holds and tanks, and a tanker loading supports deck and ballast work.

Western Harbour, Alexandria — container, general cargo, ro-ro and bulk berths; empty-hold and tank gauging after discharge, deck work during cargo operations.
El Dekheila — container and dry-bulk berths west of the city; grain carriers' holds gauged between discharge and sailing in ballast.

Alexandria outer anchorage — ships waiting outside the harbour for a berth; tank, hatch and deck readings taken after a launch transfer arranged by the agent.

context.h: Regulation, emissions and market context in Alexandria
p: Egypt carries out port state control as a member of the Mediterranean MoU, through the Egyptian Authority for Maritime Safety, and Alexandria sees a steady stream of ageing bulkers and general cargo tonnage in the grain and short-sea trades. For those ships, the structural items an inspector notices first, such as hatch coaming wastage, thinned ventilator coamings and corroded deck fittings, are the same items that become conditions of class if they are left. A recent thickness report on board, covering the areas an inspector is likely to question, shortens the conversation with class when a finding is raised.

The Mediterranean SOx emission control area took effect on 1 May 2025, so ships in Alexandria and along the Egyptian Mediterranean coast need fuel at or below 0.10% sulphur, or a scrubber, to comply. That has put scrubber wash-water and overboard piping on ships trading between the Mediterranean and the Red Sea under closer attention, because the ECA asks more of each system across the whole Mediterranean leg. Grain charter parties also bring hold condition into commercial focus: holds must be clean and fit for grain on arrival at the load port, and a ship whose frames and brackets are known to be sound is easier to fix for its next cargo.

jobs.p: Requests for ship inspection in Alexandria follow the port's three trades: grain carriers discharging wheat, tankers loading crude at Sidi Kerir, and ships going into Alexandria Shipyard for repair. Each scenario below is matched to the window that trade offers, and each is planned against the ship's survey status and the access the berth or yard allows before the team leaves India.
list: Hold frame, bracket and hopper plating gauging on a supramax after wheat discharge at El Dekheila, ahead of its intermediate survey, so findings are dealt with before class attends.
Renewal survey gauging programme on an Egyptian-managed general cargo ship docked at Alexandria Shipyard, measuring bottom, side shell and tanks before the steel list is fixed.
Deck plating, ballast tank and deck cargo line gauging at Sidi Kerir during loading, for an operator preparing an older crude tanker for its next vetting inspection.
Scrubber wash-water and overboard pipe measurement on a container ship alongside in the Western Harbour, building a trend for lines now worked harder in the Mediterranean ECA.
At the end of a time charter in Alexandria, off-hire gauging of a bulk carrier's holds, tanks and deck, recorded for both the owner's and the charterer's files.

logistics: Borg El Arab International Airport serves Alexandria directly, and Cairo International Airport offers wider international connections with road transfer north to the coast. The shipyard, the harbour terminals and Sidi Kerir are all security-controlled, so the ship's agent obtains entry permits for the team and its instruments ahead of arrival, using passport details, and arranges launches for anchorage boardings. Egyptian visas for the team are arranged before travel from India; once the docking date or the discharge window is known, we fix the mobilisation around it and confirm the plan with the superintendent.
vessels: Bulk carriers in the grain trade

faqs.q: What is the right moment to gauge the holds of a grain carrier in Alexandria?
faqs.a: Straight after discharge, before the ship sails in ballast. The holds are empty and dry, the frames and brackets are accessible from the tank top, and no cargo programme competes for time. If the ship carries a cherry-picker or the agent can arrange one, upper frames can be measured too; otherwise the team works from the tank top and the hopper slopes.

faqs.q: Can you provide Alexandria Shipyard thickness measurement for a renewal survey?
faqs.a: We can gauge a ship during its stay at Alexandria Shipyard, working with the yard's access and the ship's survey programme. Send us the class survey status, the previous thickness report and the dock dates; we prepare the measurement plan before the team travels and report in the format the ship's class society uses for thickness measurement.

faqs.q: Do you do tanker gauging at Sidi Kerir while the ship is loading?
faqs.a: Yes, for the parts of the ship that can be reached safely during loading: deck plating, deck pipelines, ballast tanks and, with the master's permission, the pump room. Cargo tanks are closed and inerted, so they wait for a gas-free period or a yard. Equipment and permits are agreed with the terminal and the ship in advance.

faqs.q: Can one mobilisation cover Alexandria and the Suez Canal ports?
faqs.a: Yes. Alexandria, Port Said, Suez and Ain Sokhna are all reachable by road within Egypt, so a team doing ship thickness gauging in Egypt can attend a grain carrier in Alexandria and a transit ship at the canal on the same visit. We sequence the attendances around each ship's schedule and report each ship separately.
